paper: Winding et al. (2023), The connectome of an insect brain, Science 379, eadd9330
authoritative_dataset_statement: Paper links raw EM/reconstructions to L1 Larval CNS CATMAID and identifies Supplementary Data S1 as connectome tables.
retrieved_copy_note: Public mirror of Winding et al. (2023) Supplementary Data S1; source claims checked against the paper data-availability section. Mirror archive retained compressed; full connectivity matrices are not extracted into the repository.

catmaid_live_audit.query_scope: Direct downstream contacts for MBON-m1→Basin-4 and MBON-d1→Ipsigoro→Goro candidate edges; no multihop Basin search is represented.

source_scope_warning: The matrix covers 2,952 neurons. It lacks the two VFB Goro IDs checked for this audit and the annotation table does not label Basin-4; it cannot alone establish the downstream route to those cells or prove their absence from the full CATMAID CNS project.
